name: Barlgura

actions.name: Leaping Slam
actions.effect: The Barlgura leaps up to 12m and slams down. All creatures within 3m of the landing point must pass PHYS save or take damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Rend
actions.effect: If the Barlgura hit the same target with Fist this turn, Rend deals an additional 2d8 damage as it tears flesh.

reactions.name: Primal Rage
reactions.effect: When the Barlgura takes damage that reduces it below half HP, it enters a frenzy. It gains +1d6 to all attack rolls and +2 damage per die for the rest of the encounter, but -3 to all defenses.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the Barlgura can gain +1d6 to all attack rolls until the start of its next turn, but attacks against it also gain +1d6.

traits.name: Climbing
traits.desc: Can climb at full speed without checks. Has advantage on grapple attempts.

lore: Barlguras are massive, ape-like demons of the Abyss. They fight with savage fury, leaping incredible distances to crash down upon their prey. Though not intelligent, their raw physical power makes them terrifying front-line fighters in demonic armies.
